Cross-Validation for cox_indi_ridge

cv.cox_indi_ridge.Rd

Selects the external weight \(\eta\) and the ridge penalty of cox_indi_ridge by cross-validation on the internal cohort. Each training fold is fitted together with the whole external cohort; the held-out score uses the internal rows only, exactly as cv.cox_indi_enet.

Usage

cv.cox_indi_ridge(
  z_int,
  delta_int,
  time_int,
  stratum_int = NULL,
  z_ext,
  delta_ext,
  time_ext,
  stratum_ext = NULL,
  etas,
  lambda = NULL,
  nlambda = 100,
  nfolds = 5,
  cv.criteria = c("V&VH", "LinPred", "CIndex_pooled", "CIndex_foldaverage"),
  c_index_stratum = NULL,
  standardize = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  ties = c("none", "breslow"),
  ...
)

Arguments

z_int, delta_int, time_int, stratum_int

Internal data, as in cox_indi_ridge.

z_ext, delta_ext, time_ext, stratum_ext

External data.

etas

Candidate weights of the external rows.

lambda

Optional common penalty path; NULL uses the path of the full-data fit at each \(\eta\).

nlambda

Path length. Default 100.

nfolds

Number of folds. Default 5.

cv.criteria

"V&VH" (default), "LinPred", "CIndex_pooled" or "CIndex_foldaverage".

c_index_stratum

Optional strata for the C-index criteria (must equal stratum_int).

standardize

Passed to cox_indi_ridge. Default TRUE.

message

Logical; progress bar.

seed

Optional seed of the fold assignment (Mersenne-Twister).

ties

"none" or "breslow".

...

Further arguments to cox_indi_ridge.

Value

An object of class "cv.cox_indi_ridge" with best, integrated_stat.full_results, integrated_stat.best_per_eta, integrated_stat.betahat_best, criteria, nfolds, folds, seed and rng_kind.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(ExampleData_indi)
cvfit <- cv.cox_indi_ridge(
  z_int = ExampleData_indi$internal$z, delta_int = ExampleData_indi$internal$status,
  time_int = ExampleData_indi$internal$time,
  z_ext = ExampleData_indi$external$z, delta_ext = ExampleData_indi$external$status,
  time_ext = ExampleData_indi$external$time,
  etas = c(0, 0.5, 1))
} # }
